rows.text: وقيل : إن الله - عز وجل - لما أوحى إلى رسوله ، ودعا قريشا إلى الإيمان ، قالوا : انبتر منا محمد ; أي خالفنا وانقطع عنا . فأخبر الله تعالى رسوله - صلى الله عليه وسلم - أنهم هم المبتورون ; قاله أيضا عكرمة وشهر بن حوشب .

And it is said: When Allah the Mighty and Majestic revealed to His Messenger and called Quraysh to faith, they said: "Muhammad has cut himself off from us"—meaning he has opposed us and severed himself from us. So Allah the Exalted informed His Messenger—may Allah's prayers and peace be upon him—that they themselves are the ones cut off; as 'Ikrimah and Shahr ibn Hawshab also said.

findings.voice_and_claim: Qurtubi frames the statement with قالوا (Quraysh's quoted speech), explains انبتر منا محمد with أي خالفنا وانقطع عنا, then states the reversal and attributes this account to Ikrimah and Shahr ibn Hawshab.
findings.bilingual: Stored English retains the Quraysh quotation, the explanatory gloss, reversal and paired authority attribution. The Arabic spelling انبتر differs from Tabari's quoted بتر; preserve the source wording.
findings.route_limit: Qurtubi's passage supplies no isnad. Al-Tabari's separate Abu Kurayb–Waki–Badr ibn Uthman route is explicitly through Ikrimah and does not name Shahr ibn Hawshab; do not attach it to the paired attribution.
findings.boundary_reconciliation: Fresh exact punctuation-bounded counts are Arabic 216 and English 384. The older Q09E staged spans count 217 and 386 because their boundaries include trailing padding; this readback records normalized boundaries and does not alter the older file.
